episode_title: [TEST FIXTURE] Casey Winters on Scaling Growth Loops vs Funnels
text:
Welcome to this test fixture episode with Casey Winters, formerly CPO at Eventbrite and growth leader at Pinterest and Grubhub.

Casey explains the fundamental shift from linear acquisition funnels to compounding growth loops. Traditional funnels pour money at the top and lose users at every stage. Growth loops, on the other hand, are closed systems where the output of one cohort of users directly feeds into the input of the next cohort.

There are several distinct types of growth loops. First, viral and referral loops, where users invite colleagues or friends to collaborate. Second, content and SEO loops, where user activities generate public content indexed by search engines, attracting new organic visitors. Third, paid reinvestment loops, where revenue from customer subscriptions is reinvested directly into performance acquisition.

To make loops work, you must measure cycle time and compounding reinvestment rate. A loop that takes six months to complete will compound far slower than a loop that runs weekly.
